name: @w6w-apps/recruiterflow
description: Manage candidates, jobs, clients, contacts, deals and users in Recruiterflow: search and update the pipeline, add candidates to jobs, move them between stages and log notes.

w6w.longDescription:
Recruiterflow is an applicant tracking system and recruiting CRM for staffing agencies and in-house recruiting teams. This app lets a workflow work the recruiting pipeline: list, fetch and search candidates, jobs, client companies, contacts, deals and users, and read the account's tags and job stage names.

On the write side it creates and updates candidates, adds a candidate to a job (as Sourced or Applied), moves them between pipeline stages by id or name, disqualifies them with a reason, and logs notes. It also creates contacts and client companies. Search actions accept Recruiterflow's own filter objects, so any saved-search style query the vendor supports is reachable.

Authentication is a single account API key. Health checks cover API reachability and the key's liveness; Recruiterflow publishes no status page.
